# togetherai_deployment (Resource)

A model deployment on a dedicated endpoint: a model plus a deployment config (hardware, quantization) and replica bounds.

Create and replica changes wait until the deployment is `DEPLOYMENT_STATE_READY`, or `DEPLOYMENT_STATE_STOPPED` when `max_replicas = 0`. Set `min_replicas` and `max_replicas` to `0` to stop the deployment without deleting it; raise them to start it again.

Destroy removes the deployment from the endpoint's traffic split, stops it, waits for `DEPLOYMENT_STATE_STOPPED`, and then deletes it, which is the order the API requires.

**Cost:** billed per minute for each ready replica (for example $5.49 per hour for one H100 replica). A stopped deployment does not bill.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "togetherai_supported_models" "gemma" {
  search  = "gemma-4-E4B-it"
  product = "PRODUCT_DEDICATED"
}

locals {
  profile = data.togetherai_supported_models.gemma.models[0].deployment_profiles[0]
}

resource "togetherai_endpoint" "chat" {
  name = "chat"
}

resource "togetherai_deployment" "stable" {
  endpoint_id = togetherai_endpoint.chat.id
  name        = "gemma-stable"
  model       = local.profile.model
  config      = local.profile.config

  autoscaling = {
    min_replicas      = 1
    max_replicas      = 3
    scale_down_window = "600s"
  }

  # Stop by itself after an hour without requests.
  inactive_timeout = 60
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `autoscaling` (Attributes) Replica bounds and autoscaling. Updated in place without restarting replicas. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling))
- `endpoint_id` (String) Endpoint ID (`togetherai_endpoint.<name>.id`).
- `model` (String) Model resource name `projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}[/revisions/{revisionId}]`, such as a `deployment_profiles[*].model` from `togetherai_supported_models`. Without a revision, the latest revision is pinned at create time (see `model_revision`). Changing it replaces the deployment.
- `name` (String) Deployment name within the endpoint. Updated in place.

### Optional

- `config` (String) Deployment config `projects/{projectId}/configs/{configRevisionId}` (hardware, quantization, parallelism), such as a `deployment_profiles[*].config`. Set it when the model has more than one deployment profile. Changing it replaces the deployment.
- `inactive_timeout` (Number) Minutes without a request before the deployment stops by itself. `0` disables it; otherwise 30 to 1440. Updated in place.
- `max_concurrent_requests_per_replica` (Number) Maximum in-flight requests per replica. Defaults to the config's limit minus one. The API lowers larger values to that maximum; the provider then reports an error asking you to use the lower value. Updated in place.
- `placement` (Attributes) Where replicas may run. Set `profile`, or `regions` with `constraint`. Placement cannot change on an existing deployment, so changing it replaces the deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--placement))
- `project_id` (String) Project of the endpoint. Defaults to the provider's project.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `desired_replicas` (Number) Replicas the autoscaler wants now.
- `hardware` (String) Hardware selected by the config, such as GPU type and count.
- `id` (String) Deployment ID.
- `model_revision` (String) The pinned model revision `projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}/revisions/{revisionId}`.
- `qualified_name` (String) `<project_slug>/<endpoint_name>/<name>`. Pass it as `model` to send a request to this deployment only, bypassing the traffic split.
- `ready_replicas` (Number) Replicas serving traffic (and billing) now.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state, such as `DEPLOYMENT_STATE_READY`.
- `status_message` (String) Human-readable status from the API.
- `traffic_mode` (String) `TRAFFIC_MODE_LIVE` or `TRAFFIC_MODE_SHADOW`.

<a id="nestedatt--autoscaling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autoscaling`

Required:

- `min_replicas` (Number) Minimum replicas. These run and bill all the time. `0` with `max_replicas = 0` stops the deployment.

Optional:

- `max_replicas` (Number) Maximum replicas. Defaults to `min_replicas`.
- `scale_down_window` (String) Time a lower replica recommendation must stay stable before scaling down, such as `"300s"` (the API default is 5 minutes).
- `scale_to_zero_window` (String) Idle period after which the deployment stops and releases its replicas, such as `"1800s"`.
- `scale_up_window` (String) Stabilization window before scaling up, in seconds, such as `"60s"`. Defaults to the API's value.
- `scaling_metrics` (Attributes List) Metrics and targets that drive replica recommendations. When not set, the API uses in-flight requests per replica. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling--scaling_metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--autoscaling--scaling_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autoscaling.scaling_metrics`

Required:

- `name` (String) Metric name: `active_sessions`, `cache_hit_rate`, `decoding_speed`, `e2e_latency`, `gpu_utilization`, `inflight_requests`, `throughput_per_replica`, `token_utilization`, `ttft`.
- `target` (Number) Target value, read according to `type` (utilization is 0-100).
- `type` (String) Target type: `METRIC_TARGET_TYPE_VALUE`, `METRIC_TARGET_TYPE_UTILIZATION`, `METRIC_TARGET_TYPE_AVERAGE_VALUE`.

Optional:

- `percentile` (String) Percentile for latency metrics: `p50`, `p90`, `p95` or `p99`.



<a id="nestedatt--placement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `placement`

Optional:

- `constraint` (String) `ENFORCEMENT_REQUIRED` or `ENFORCEMENT_PREFERRED`.
- `profile` (String) Placement profile ID (`pp_...`).
- `regions` (List of String) Region names or patterns such as `us-*` or `us-east-*`.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a deployment by endpoint ID and deployment ID...
terraform import togetherai_deployment.stable <endpoint_id>/<deployment_id>

# ...or with the project too.
terraform import togetherai_deployment.stable <project_id>/<endpoint_id>/<deployment_id>
```
